name: HD Fire Protect Limited
summary: HD Fire Protect Limited manufactures and supplies fire protection equipment and systems in India. The company offers sprinklers, flexible sprinkler drops, alarm valves, and accessories; deluge valves, deluge skids and pre-action systems; water spray nozzles; monitors and monitor nozzles; foam proportioning systems, foam equipment and devices, foam concentrates, and mobile equipment; systems valves and accessories, and handline nozzles; co2 fire suspension systems and inert gas fire suppression systems; and customized engineered systems, as well as spanning water suppression systems.
